offline.title: Can’t reach BranchHarbor
offline.body: Check your internet connection. Nothing is shown until the service is reachable again, and your data is safe.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: We couldn’t load your business account. Try again in a moment.

notAvailable.title: Not available
notAvailable.body: This page isn’t part of your access in {business}. If you need it, ask an owner or admin to add it.

account.title: Business accounts
account.note: Each business account has one industry and its own data. Nothing is shared between accounts.

network.name: Network
network.description: Locations, approvals and performance across the network.

training.name: Training
training.description: Courses and certification for the network.

community.name: Community
community.description: Announcements and support for the network.

home.emptyBody: Your access in {business} doesn’t include any screens yet. Ask an owner or admin to give you the modules you need.

linkDescriptions.websites: Domains, publishing and the status of each location’s website.
linkDescriptions.territories: Franchise territories: what’s available, reserved or sold.
linkDescriptions.financeReports: Royalty, fund and payout reports to download.
linkDescriptions.rules: Jurisdiction rules: disclosure, waiting and cooling-off periods.

publish.name: Publish / approve
publish.description: Make changes live and decide requests.

locations.name: Locations
locations.description: The location directory: addresses, opening hours, status and local details.

approvals.name: Approvals
approvals.description: Requests waiting for a decision: refunds over the limit, local ad spend, shift swaps and website changes.

reports.name: Reports
reports.description: Performance reports for the locations in scope. Revenue figures also need Payments.

templates.name: Brand templates & policies
templates.description: Website templates, locked brand fields and business policies set by HQ.

onboarding.name: New locations
onboarding.description: Onboarding checklists, pre-opening checks and go-live requests for new locations. Franchise owners see the projects of their own locations and their own franchise agreement.

classes.name: Classes & schedule
classes.description: Class timetable, bookings, check-in, attendance and cover.

schedule_builder.name: Schedule builder
schedule_builder.description: Recurring class series, class types and booking policies.

rooms.name: Rooms
rooms.description: Rooms per location, their capacity and features.

packs_offers.name: Pricing, packs & offers
packs_offers.description: Membership plans, class packs and introductory offers.

schedule_builder.name: Schedule builder
schedule_builder.description: Season schedules, schedule proposals and venues.

practitioners.name: Practitioners & hours
practitioners.description: Practitioners, their working hours, and rooms or equipment.

services.name: Services & packages
services.description: Services, packages, gift vouchers and intake forms.

catalogue.name: Catalog
catalogue.description: Products, assortment per location and the online store.

inventory.name: Inventory
inventory.description: Stock levels, counts and transfers between stores.

menu.name: Menu
menu.description: Menus, item builder, availability and ingredients.

food_orders.name: Orders & kitchen
food_orders.description: Orders, kitchen display, pickup, delivery and tables.

catering.name: Catering & meal plans
catering.description: Catering menus and events, meal plans and production dates, delivery zones and providers.

portals.name: Portal feeds
portals.description: Which listings go to which property portals.

agents.name: Agents & offices
agents.description: Agents, their own lead settings and offices.

offices.name: Offices & lead routing
offices.description: Office settings and how enquiries are routed between agents.

reservations.name: Front desk & reservations
reservations.description: Today at the property, the room grid, reservations, check-in and check-out, folios and guest registration.

rooms.name: Rooms & rates
rooms.description: Room types, rooms, rate plans, seasons, restrictions, taxes, policies and channel exports. Changing them also needs Locations (edit).

outlets.name: Restaurant outlet
outlets.description: Restaurant and bar orders for guests, charged to the room.

hotel_reports.name: Hotel reports
hotel_reports.description: Occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, pickup and cancellations per property.

customers.name: Customers
customers.description: Customer records with contact details and history (personal data).

franchise_pipeline.name: Franchise pipeline
franchise_pipeline.description: Franchise enquiries, qualification, disclosure and agreement steps, territories and new-location deals.

course_leads.name: Course leads
course_leads.description: People interested in teacher training and public courses. Trainers see the leads assigned to them; Academy publish across the business sees and assigns all.

website_builder.name: Websites
website_builder.description: Location websites: pages, approvals, publishing and domains.

campaigns.name: Campaigns
campaigns.description: Marketing campaigns and offers for the locations in scope.

payments.name: Payments
payments.description: Transactions, refunds, reconciliation and payment accounts (financial data).

business.name: Business settings
business.description: Business details, defaults, data sharing and AI preferences.

team.name: Team & access
team.description: Invite people and decide what each person can see.

connections.name: Connections
connections.description: Connected systems and their sync health.

ai.name: AI assistant
ai.description: Ask Marina about the data this person can already see. It only drafts and proposes.

agreements.name: Franchise agreements
agreements.description: The agreements register, executed agreements, the legal document vault, renewals and expiries.

disclosure.name: Disclosure & jurisdiction rules
disclosure.description: Disclosure documents, registrations and the jurisdiction rules (waiting and cooling-off periods) per jurisdiction. Approve = record counsel’s review of a rule.

academy.name: Academy
academy.description: Courses, lessons, quizzes and certificates for staff and franchisees, and public courses sold on the brand site. Edit = write courses; publish = manage every course, path and certificate.

assignments.name: Assignments & progress
assignments.description: Assign courses to the people in your scope and follow their progress.

announcements.name: Announcements
announcements.description: News and required reads from HQ to the network, with read receipts. Publish = send announcements.

discussions.name: Discussions & events
discussions.description: Discussion spaces, events and private coaching threads between HQ and franchisees. Edit = post and reply; publish = moderate.

library.name: Resource library
library.description: Manuals, brand files and how-tos shared with the network. Edit = manage folders and files.

help_desk.name: Help desk
help_desk.description: Questions and support requests from locations to HQ. View = raise and follow your own requests; edit = answer as an HQ agent.

org_owner.name: Owner
org_owner.description: Everything, including billing, ownership and who has access.

hq_admin.name: HQ admin
hq_admin.description: Runs the network: locations, brand templates, websites, marketing, approvals, reports, team and connections. No customer records or payments.

development_lead.name: Development lead
development_lead.description: Franchise development: the franchise pipeline and territories, disclosure and agreements, and new locations. No customer sales.

development_rep.name: Development rep
development_rep.description: Works franchise inquiries through the pipeline and sends disclosure. Agreements and approvals stay with the lead.

sales_lead.name: Sales lead
sales_lead.description: Customer sales: leads and deals, routing rules, customers, memberships and packages, and course leads.

sales_rep.name: Sales rep
sales_rep.description: Works leads and deals, follows up customers and course leads, and sells memberships and packages.

marketing_lead.name: Marketing lead
marketing_lead.description: All marketing across the network, brand templates, announcements, marketing reports and the marketing fund report.

brand_manager.name: Brand manager
brand_manager.description: Brand assets, brand templates and locked fields, websites and social content.

digital_marketer.name: Digital marketer
digital_marketer.description: Websites, social, ads, email and network campaigns. No operations, customers or finance.

content_social.name: Content & social
content_social.description: Drafts posts, emails, website pages and campaigns; publishing needs someone with publish rights.

operations_lead.name: Operations lead
operations_lead.description: Day-to-day operations across the network: locations, approvals, new locations, audits, support and the help desk. No finance.

field_consultant.name: Field consultant
field_consultant.description: Business coach for a portfolio of locations: views and supports them, runs audits and coaching threads. No owner finances or customer data.

finance_lead.name: Finance lead
finance_lead.description: Payments, refunds, reconciliation, royalties, invoices, the marketing fund, payouts and financial reports.

accountant.name: Accountant
accountant.description: Reads and exports payments, statements, royalties, payouts and fund reports for the books. Changes nothing.

legal_lead.name: Legal lead
legal_lead.description: Franchise agreements, disclosure, registrations and jurisdiction rules across the network.

training_lead.name: Training lead
training_lead.description: The academy: every course, learning path and certificate, assignments and training reports.

trainer.name: Trainer
trainer.description: Writes and teaches courses, assigns them and follows learners’ progress.

master_franchisee.name: Master franchisee
master_franchisee.description: Runs a territory (for example a country) like HQ: its locations, franchise pipeline, new locations, community, training, team and finances.

area_developer.name: Area developer
area_developer.description: Owns the units of a development schedule: the full dashboard for their own units, plus the franchise pipeline of their territory.

area_representative.name: Area representative
area_representative.description: Supports franchisees in a territory they don’t own: views, supports and audits their locations. No owner finances unless granted.

multi_unit_operator.name: Multi-unit operator
multi_unit_operator.description: Runs an owner group with several units: the full dashboard for every unit of the group, its team and its finances.

franchise_owner.name: Franchise owner
franchise_owner.description: The full dashboard for their own locations: operations, marketing, customers, payments and their team. Nothing from other franchisees or HQ-private areas.

location_manager.name: Location manager
location_manager.description: Runs a location day to day: operations, customers, the local website and campaign drafts.

staff.name: Staff
staff.description: Their own shifts, classes and appointments, cover requests and check-in at their location, plus community and training.

auditor.name: Auditor
auditor.description: Read-only view of locations and operations, and runs audits. No finance, legal files or customer data.

customer.name: Customer
customer.description: Their own bookings, orders and preferences in the customer app.

roleAdmin.intro: Start from a role template or build your own role by ticking modules and actions. People only see what their roles give them.
roleAdmin.customEmpty: No custom roles yet. Create one when a job doesn’t match a template.
roleAdmin.assigned: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody has this role.} one {# person has this role.} other {# people have this role.}}
roleAdmin.name: Role name
roleAdmin.appliesNow: {count, plural, one {Saving changes access for # person immediately.} other {Saving changes access for # people immediately.}}
roleAdmin.scopeNote: Where a role applies (whole business, brand, territory, region, portfolio, owner group or location) is chosen when you give it to someone. HQ-only modules work only for business-wide roles; a territory also runs its own franchise pipeline.
roleAdmin.templatesIntro: Templates are starting points, not an org chart. Rename them to your job titles, give a person several roles, or build your own.
roleAdmin.emptyStart: New roles start empty: tick only what this role needs.

editor.title: What can {name} see?
editor.intro: Tick the modules and actions this person needs. Anything not ticked is not shown to them at all, and the server refuses it.
editor.overrides: {count, plural, one {# personal change} other {# personal changes}}
editor.ownerNote: Owners always have full access. Ownership can only be changed by another owner.
editor.readOnly: You can see this access but not change it: it includes access you don’t have yourself.
editor.notEditable: You can’t change this person’s access.
editor.hqOnly: HQ only: needs access to the whole business.
editor.notHeld: You don’t have this yourself, so you can’t give it.
editor.saved: Saved. {added, plural, =0 {Nothing added} one {# action added} other {# actions added}}, {removed, plural, =0 {nothing removed} one {# removed} other {# removed}}. It applies from their next click.
editor.previewNothing: Nothing yet — tick at least one module.
editor.unionNote: This person has several roles. They get everything any of their roles gives (the union); “Never show” limits apply to all of them.
editor.reaches: {count, plural, =0 {No locations yet} one {Reaches # location: {names}} other {Reaches # locations: {names}…}}
editor.templateSaved: Saved as the role “{name}”. You’ll find it under Roles.

preview.title: Effective access
preview.intro: Exactly what this person will get when you save, as the server computes it. Anything not listed stays hidden.
preview.sensitiveNone: None: no finance, legal files or customer personal data.

profile.jobTitleHint: Free text, shown next to their name. It doesn’t change what they can see.
profile.denyHint: Removes this kind of data from every role the person holds, even if a role includes it.
profile.saved: Saved. It applies from their next click.

shape.title: Team shape
shape.intro: How your HQ team is organized. It only suggests roles to start from; you can change it at any time.
shape.onboardingIntro: We’ll suggest roles to match. Role templates are starting points, not an org chart: rename, combine or change them later in Team & access.
shape.smallNote: We’ll create combined roles such as “Marketing & sales” and “Operations & finance” for people who cover several areas.
shape.nothingLocked: Nothing is locked: changing the shape never removes roles or anyone’s access.

full.title: Full team
full.body: Separate sales, marketing, operations, finance and development teams.

small.title: Small team
small.body: People cover several areas: combined roles like “Marketing & sales”.

solo.title: Just me for now
solo.body: You run everything. Add people when you’re ready.

custom.title: Custom
custom.body: Build your own roles from modules and actions.

marketing_sales.name: Marketing & sales
marketing_sales.description: Marketing across the network plus customer sales: leads, deals and memberships.

operations_finance.name: Operations & finance
operations_finance.description: Day-to-day operations plus payments, royalties, invoices and payouts.

development_training.name: Franchise development & training
development_training.description: The franchise pipeline, disclosure, agreements and new locations, plus the academy.

coverage.title: Uncovered areas
coverage.countOpen: {count, plural, one {# area has nobody yet} other {# areas have nobody yet}}
coverage.fallback: Until someone is assigned, approvals and notifications for these go to the owner.

scopes.title: Portfolios and territories
scopes.intro: Scopes beyond regions and owner groups. A portfolio is any set of locations (for a field consultant). A territory is a sub-network, such as a country run by a master franchisee, with its own locations and franchise pipeline.
scopes.locationCount: {count, plural, =0 {No locations} one {# location} other {# locations}}
scopes.countryHint: Two-letter code, e.g. IE. Jurisdiction rules of this country can be granted to the territory.
scopes.membersHint: Assigning gives the person the role for exactly these locations. You can only give access you hold yourself.

demo.ribbonNote: Sample businesses and people for demonstration. Not real customers.

picker.title: Try a demo account
picker.body: Sign in as anyone on these sample teams to see what each role sees.
picker.failed: Demo accounts aren’t available right now.
